candidate.subject: government
candidate.question: The terms oligarchy and democracy identify governments according to

options.A: the number of people who participate in it
options.C: formal distribution of power among governmental levels

candidate.explanation: Oligarchy places rule in the hands of a few, while democracy gives the people a role in choosing and controlling government. This classification concerns the breadth of political participation.

options.A: official majority in the legislative council

candidate.explanation: The Richards Constitution provided an unofficial majority in the central legislature. Unofficial membership did not mean that every member was elected, and colonial executive control remained.
